model_family: exact shared-timescale unit-amplitude RBF GPFA; constrained standard GPFA
initialization: Existing verified half1-train-only FA100: first q loadings, discarded loading variance added to diagonal noise; then independent Gaussian loading jitter with per-column SD=1% of its SD, seed-specific. All GPFA parameters jointly refined by EM.
fit_scope: 47 physical training conditions, half1 only; no position, half2, validation, or test used in GPFA likelihood/parameter updates/stopping
primary_inference: causal E[x_t|y_1:t], reset per condition, frozen train normalization and parameters
auxiliary_inference: current-only posterior under identical GPFA parameters (q32/64 seed42)
position_protocol: Separate train-half1 OLS and Ridge per inference mode; Ridge alpha selected by validation xy MSE; test only scored; 2(q+1) coefficients
trajectory_scope: Train-only ZCA/floor; held-out original half pair and matched-support within-partition deranged condition null; no repeated split reliability claim
comparison_scope: Same dimension and upper parameter budget, actual parameter counts reported; not equal parameter counts/FLOPs. AE checkpoints already selected/evaluated; all follow-up held-out comparisons exploratory.
gpfa_model_selection: Report pre-specified full dimension grid; any suggested dimension based on validation only, never held-out test; q32/64 primary replicated comparisons fixed before GPFA fitting
source_limitations: Published imputed condition-average pseudo-population, not raw simultaneous trials. This only prevents additional future use by this inference pipeline.
